title: Amtrak separates 240 completed, 74 active, and 132 upcoming construction projects
summary: Amtrak reports 240 station construction projects completed, 74 in progress, and 132 upcoming in the June 2026 program inventory. Denominator: The report's 446 construction-project status entries, preserved as 240 completed, 74 in progress, and 132 upcoming rather than collapsed into a completion rate for stations.
